system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each LLM-powered agent has skills associated with it, which are python functions that are described to the LLM for function calling.
system_prompt_style.note: System prompts for planner/browser nav agents; exact rendering code not in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Sensing Skills: Skills like `get_dom_with_content_type` and `geturl` that help the agent understand the current state of the webpage

context_compaction.evidence_quote: We've introduced DOM Distillation to pare down the DOM to just the elements pertinent to the user's task.
context_compaction.note: DOM distillation prunes observations; also nested chat is freshly instantiated per sub-task.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
`text_only`: Extracts the inner text of the html DOM. Responds with text output.
- `input_fields`: Extracts the interactive elements in the DOM (button, input, textarea, etc.) and responds with a compact JSON object.
observation_format.note: "we use the DOM Accessibility Tree rather than the regular HTML DOM" -> a11y_tree; screenshots only an optional test flag.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: which are python functions that are described to the LLM for function calling

tool_count.evidence_quote: | `get_user_input` - Provides the orchestrator with a mechanism to receive user feedback to disambiguate or seek clarity on fulfilling their request. | `bulk_enter_text` - Optimized method that wraps enter_text method so that multiple text entries can be performed one shot. |
tool_count.note: Skills table lists geturl, get_dom_with_content_type, get_user_input, click, enter_text_and_click, bulk_enter_text, enter_text, openurl = 8 listed; get_user_input disabled by default (PLANNER_USER_INPUT_SKILL_ENABLED default false), so 7 in default browser-nav config.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Agent-E is an agent based system that aims to automate actions on the user's computer. At the moment it focuses on automation within the browser.
edit_primitive.note: Skills library is web actions only; no file-editing tool registered.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: which are python functions that are described to the LLM for function calling
tool_schema_source.note: AutoGen registers python functions with docstring/type-derived schemas.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The system is based on on [AG2 agent framework](https://docs.ag2.ai/docs/Home).
protocol_standardization.note: No MCP/A2A mentioned anywhere in README or paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Given a new user task, the planner decomposes the task into a sequence of steps that need to be executed. The next step is then delegated to the browser navigation agent for execution.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the planner decomposes the task into a sequence of steps that need to be executed
planning_granularity.note: Plan exists in planner chat text, not a stored structured object per evidence.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We introduce a novel hierarchical architecture for web agents that enables the execution of more complex tasks through a clear separation of roles and responsibilities between a planner agent and a browser navigation agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Browser navigation agent is implemented as a nested chat that is freshly instantiated by the Planner for each run

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
**`PLANNER_USER_INPUT_SKILL_ENABLED`** *(optional)*
Set to `true` or `false` (Default: `false`). Specifies whether to allow the planner agent to get user input or not.
human_in_loop.note: Default is autonomous (false); human-in-the-loop mode reachable by config.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Browser navigation agent is implemented as a nested chat that is freshly instantiated by the Planner for each run (i.e., it does not contain previous steps in its chat history).

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Fills the form using information from memory defined in user preferences.txt
long_term_memory.note: user preferences.txt file read across runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Browser navigation agent is implemented as a nested chat that is freshly instantiated by the Planner for each run
state_persistence.note: No resume path described in README or paper.

self_verification.evidence_quote: All the action skills are designed to not only execute an action but also report on any change in state as an outcome of the action, a concept we call ‘Change observation’.
self_verification.note: Planner verifies sub-task outcomes; no harness-run tests or linters.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: This loop is executed iteratively until the task is completed.
retry_policy.note: No task-level retry described; planner may re-delegate steps within the run.

rollback.evidence_quote: We illustrate the utility of the hierarchical architecture for capabilities such as task verification, backtracking, and error recovery
rollback.note: Backtracking is planner-level replanning, not a state rollback mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: reporting its task success or failure back to the planner. This loop is executed iteratively until the task is completed.
termination_condition.note: AutoGen max turn caps likely exist but not visible in evidence.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: a good proxy for cost is number of LLM calls involved
cost_controls.note: Cost is only measured, not capped; no budget/caching config documented.

timeouts.evidence_quote: `--wait_time_non_headless`: The amount of time to wait between headless tests.
timeouts.note: Only a test wait parameter; no agent-enforced tool/run timeout documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Agent-E is an agent based system that aims to automate actions on the user's computer.
execution_isolation.note: Runs in-process via `python -m ae.main` driving a local Playwright/Chrome browser; browser is the action boundary.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: If you want to use local chrome browser over playwright browser, go to chrome://version/ in chrome, find the path to your profile and set `BROWSER_STORAGE_DIR` to the path value
filesystem_access.note: Runs on host with user profile; no sandboxing described.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Agent-E operates in a real-world web environment, which introduces variability in testing.
network_policy.note: Live web browsing, no network restriction documented.

permission_model.evidence_quote: We chose to use skills that map to what humans learn about the web browser rather than allow the LLM to write code as it pleases. We see the use of configured skills to be safer and more predictable in its outcomes.
permission_model.note: Fixed registered skill set is the only action surface; no per-call approval by default.

tracing.evidence_quote:
**`LOG_MESSAGES_FORMAT`**
Set to `json` or `text` (Default: `text`). Specifies the format for logging messages.
tracing.note: JSON chat-log format is selectable; no per-step trace schema documented.

replayability.evidence_quote:
**`SAVE_CHAT_LOGS_TO_FILE`**
Set to `true` or `false` (Default: `true`). Indicates whether to save chat logs to a file or print them to stdout.
replayability.note: Logs saved but no replay mechanism documented.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
To run the full test suite, use the following command:

```bash
python -m test.run_tests
```
eval_hooks.note: test/ harness with task JSON files, built on WebArena evaluation.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Certainly it can click on the wrong things, but at least it is not going to execute malicious unknown code.
guardrails.note: Constrained skill set acts as the action policy.

target_domain.evidence_quote: At the moment it focuses on automation within the browser.

open_source.note: LICENSE file not shown in evidence.
